title: Extension by zero of the unit module is flat
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and let $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ be the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$, the extension-by-zero module sheaf $j_{U!}\mathcal O_U$ is flat over $\mathcal O$ [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]: tensoring with it over $\mathcal O$ preserves finite limits (equivalently, the tensor functor on $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ is exact).
